description: This is a JavaScript source file that initializes a React application by rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the App component, then creates a root and renders the application within React's StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root to enable rendering React components into a DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM within the specified root.
